Cap widget, bundled so that visitors' browsers load nothing from a CDN.

  cap.min.js             @cap.js/widget 0.1.58   Apache-2.0   https://github.com/tiagozip/cap (widget/)
  cap_wasm_bg.wasm       @cap.js/wasm 0.0.8      Apache-2.0   https://github.com/tiagozip/cap (wasm/)
  hashwx.wasm            @cap.js/wasm 0.0.8      Apache-2.0   https://github.com/tiagozip/cap (wasm/)
  pako_inflate.min.js    pako 2.1.0              MIT, Zlib    https://github.com/nodeca/pako

The files are unmodified copies from the npm packages of the same names and versions.
pako is only loaded by browsers without DecompressionStream.
